desc: With a legacy built on precision engineering and relentless innovation, the Beretta 1301 Tactical Mod.2 Shotgun emerges as the natural successor setting standards for excellence in the realm of tactical shotguns. It boasts an upgraded forend with aggressive knurling ensuring a firm grip and three sections of M-Lok for ease of attachments. A semi-flat tactical style trigger offers a crisp break with minimal reset and a Pro-Lifter allows for effortless reloading. The power of the B-LINK gas-system combined with the precision of the rotating bolt ensures you fast, reliable and smart cycling. Whether you are a professional operator, a dedicated competitor, or a home defender, this shotgun delivers the performance you need.
